full_prompt_en: A square expressionist oil portrait fills the frame with a closely cropped face, divided between intense yellow-green illumination and deep blue-black shadow. There is no separate setting: dark navy and near-black paint press in from the left and right edges, making the face seem to emerge directly from a dense painted ground. The forehead and the right side of the face are covered by broad acidic yellow and pale green strokes. A thick dark eyebrow and one large blue-green eye sit high on the right, with red and black marks sharpening the eyelid. The other eye is partly lost in the heavy shadow on the left, remaining only a pale glint surrounded by darkness. A narrow pink nose falls near the center. Below it, vividly red lips become the second main focal point, their edges broken by black and crimson brush marks. The lower jaw turns cool blue-gray before disappearing into the dark base, while black hair and a dark shoulder-like mass close the upper and right margins. The portrait's anatomy is recognizable but deliberately unsettled by sudden changes of color and rough, exposed strokes. Some paint has been dragged vertically through the bright cheek, and darker marks cut across it without smoothing the boundary. The apparent light comes from the upper front-right, bleaching the lit planes into yellow while leaving the left side and lower edges in dense cobalt shadow. There is little air or depth beyond these color masses. The overall composition is confrontational and intimate, using the shock of luminous yellow, saturated red, and abyssal blue-black to turn a close expression into a raw painted presence.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形表现主义油画肖像以紧密裁切的面孔填满画幅，脸部被强烈黄绿色亮光与深蓝黑阴影分开。没有独立背景：藏蓝与近黑色颜料从左右两缘压入，使面孔仿佛直接从浓厚涂绘底面浮现。额头与脸部右侧由宽阔的酸黄和浅绿笔触覆盖。右上方一条粗深眉下是一只大的蓝绿色眼睛，红黑痕迹强调眼睑。另一只眼睛部分消失在左侧重影里，只剩被黑暗包围的一点浅色闪光。细窄的粉色鼻子落在中央附近。其下鲜红的嘴唇成为第二视觉焦点，边缘被黑色和绯红笔迹打断。下颌转为冷蓝灰，然后消失在深色基底中，黑发和肩部般的深暗量块收住上缘和右缘。面部结构可辨，却被骤变的颜色和粗糙外露的笔触刻意扰动。有些颜料沿明亮面颊向下拖动，较深痕迹横切其上，没有磨平边界。光线似乎从右前上方照来，将受光平面漂成黄色，左侧和下缘则留在浓重钴蓝影里。除这些色块外，几乎没有空气或纵深。整体构图逼近而亲密，以明亮黄色、饱和红和深渊般蓝黑的冲击，把近距离神情化为原始的绘画存在。
style_prompt_en: An expressionist oil-paint treatment pushes extreme value and hue contrast through broad, visible, sometimes vertically dragged strokes. Acid yellow and pale green form a large luminous zone, pressed against saturated cobalt, navy, and almost solid black; sharp red accents gather at a smaller focal point. Boundaries are cut by rough marks rather than smoothly blended, and a few exposed underlayers keep the paint physically immediate. One side of a central form is bleached by hard upper-side light while the other sinks into a dense cool shadow, producing volume through abrupt color division. The image is tightly cropped with little background air, so masses of pigment fill nearly every edge. Fine detail appears only where the visual emphasis requires it, surrounded by raw broader marks. The overall effect is emotionally charged, direct, and tactile, with color acting as structure rather than surface decoration.
style_prompt_zh: 表现主义油画以宽阔、可见且偶尔向下拖动的笔触推动极端明度与色相反差。酸黄和浅绿形成大片明亮区域，与饱和钴蓝、藏蓝和近乎纯黑相挤压；尖锐红色重点聚在较小焦点。边界被粗糙笔痕切开，而非平滑晕合，少量露出的底层令颜料有直接的物质感。中央形体一侧被来自上方一边的强光照亮，另一侧沉入浓重冷影，以骤然分开的颜色产生体积。画面裁切极紧，背景空气极少，颜料团块几乎填满每个边缘。细节只在视觉重点所需处出现，周围是更原始宽大的笔迹。整体情绪强烈、直接且可触，颜色承担结构，而非表面装饰。
theme_en: A tightly cropped face divided between fluorescent yellow light and blue-black shadow
theme_zh: 紧密裁切的面孔被荧黄色光与蓝黑阴影分开
name: 高饱和新表现主义肖像
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
